reasons: The redline reaches the playbook fallback with minimal, targeted edits: duration cut from three years to twelve (12) months, scope narrowed from all Licensor/Affiliate employees to personnel directly involved in the Agreement, and the obligation made mutual ('neither party ... the other party').
The pre-existing general-advertising and voluntary-inquiry carve-out is preserved verbatim and there is no no-hire language, so no further edits are required.

The failed deterministic duration check is a phrasing artifact — the clause spells the period as 'twelve (12) month period', which satisfies the ≤12-month requirement; the 0.47 changed-character ratio reflects the necessary mutuality/scope rewrite, not over-editing.

Comment is accurate, correctly cites the playbook position (three years covering all Licensor and Affiliate employees is outside our position), and explains the changes concisely in the required tone and prefix.

Minor, non-disqualifying deviation: the fallback measures 12 months from the end of the individual's involvement whereas the redline runs from expiration/termination — an acceptable, commercially equivalent formulation.
